surfaces.name: flow skill dispatch procedure
surfaces.proposedOwnerOrRemovalDecision: Retain only safety-critical dispatch rules in skill and move routine step metadata to CLI envelopes.
behaviorVerifications: User approval and destructive recovery choices are still presented before execution.

surfaces.name: senti flow get next-action envelope
surfaces.proposedOwnerOrRemovalDecision: Own normal step branching, context, output_schema, requires_approval, maxAttempts, and retryRecovery.
surfaces.fallbackOwner: Existing next-action envelope plus skill instructions
behaviorVerifications: Envelope includes step, action, instructions, context, output_schema, requires_approval, and maxAttempts.

surfaces.name: senti flow run review --phase draft
surfaces.proposedOwnerOrRemovalDecision: Keep review command owner and add manifest/coverage inputs only as pre-AI evidence.
behaviorVerifications: Draft review PASS/FAIL artifacts preserve blocking/advisory/repair target buckets.

surfaces.name: senti flow run review --phase spec
surfaces.proposedOwnerOrRemovalDecision: Add spec manifest precheck while preserving full AI review fallback.
behaviorVerifications: Known blocking spec-review findings are represented or trigger full AI review.

surfaces.name: senti flow run review --phase test
surfaces.proposedOwnerOrRemovalDecision: Add coverage matrix input while preserving static anti-pattern review.
behaviorVerifications: Coverage matrix does not count skipped or helper-only tests as executable coverage.

surfaces.name: implementation review command path
surfaces.proposedOwnerOrRemovalDecision: Use review manifest to summarize diff/test evidence and keep full AI fallback for semantic failures.
behaviorVerifications: missing_acceptance_requirement, spec_behavior_contradiction, and security_or_data_integrity_bug remain detectable.

surfaces.name: senti flow run gate
surfaces.proposedOwnerOrRemovalDecision: Add deterministic prechecks for obvious missing evidence and preserve AI gate for undecidable requirements.
behaviorVerifications: Obvious missing file-map/test evidence fails before AI and undecidable requirements retain AI judgment.

surfaces.name: senti flow get context --search
surfaces.proposedOwnerOrRemovalDecision: Prefer deterministic search and require explicit allowance for AI keyword fallback.
behaviorVerifications: AI keyword selection runs only when deterministic search is insufficient and fallback is explicitly allowed.

surfaces.name: senti flow run auto-check
surfaces.proposedOwnerOrRemovalDecision: Use rule-based obvious pass/fail scoring and keep AI scoring for boundary cases.
behaviorVerifications: Boundary cases still include AI scoring with the same hard-gate categories.

surfaces.name: senti flow run finalize-sync
surfaces.proposedOwnerOrRemovalDecision: Separate deterministic docs sync from AI-capable docs work when policy permits.
behaviorVerifications: Docs commit behavior remains available and deferred AI docs work creates warning or follow-up evidence.

surfaces.name: senti docs build pipeline
surfaces.proposedOwnerOrRemovalDecision: Classify deterministic scan/init/data separately from AI-capable enrich/text/readme/agents/translate.
behaviorVerifications: Docs review passes and unresolved directives are not introduced.

surfaces.name: AI JSON repair behavior
surfaces.proposedOwnerOrRemovalDecision: Use schema-aware normalizer before AI repair or hard fail.
surfaces.fallbackOwner: Existing AI repair or command failure path
behaviorVerifications: Raw response and normalized output are preserved for audit.

surfaces.name: flow-findings artifact
surfaces.proposedOwnerOrRemovalDecision: Store grouped findings without deleting original members.
behaviorVerifications: Grouped artifact retains sourceStep, sourceArtifact, member findings, severity, and evidenceRefs.

surfaces.name: issue-log artifact
surfaces.proposedOwnerOrRemovalDecision: Allow deterministic finding summaries to seed issue-log candidates but keep explicit audit text.
behaviorVerifications: Issue-log entries still include step, reason, trigger, resolution, and timestamp.

surfaces.name: acceptance-review evidence artifact
surfaces.proposedOwnerOrRemovalDecision: Generate suggestedDisposition and evidenceRefs when latest test-review blocking count is zero and coverage updated.
behaviorVerifications: Acceptance evidence preserves source artifacts and does not auto-close unresolved blocking findings.
